post.summary: Connect or replace the agent audio transport
post.description: Session cookie or bearer session only. The device belongs to the signed-in user. Connection is separate from customer dispatch: it does not claim or call the first contact, add a customer debit or take another customer hold. Keep current audio until connection_state is active. Accepted, answered and ready states alone do not prove a completed handoff. Retain the intent UUID on retry; uncertain provider creation is recovered without another create. A manual call issued without a saved parent continuation returns 409 and keeps its existing audio. Manual calls permit one unresolved customer promotion; a new intent cannot replace it after its phone ends. Confirmed topology retains the original room and first callback owner for later phones. Closed topology cannot create another room while terminal customer status is delayed.

delete.summary: Cancel a pending audio replacement or idle connection
delete.description: Cancel only this agent transport. Cancel by submitted intent can precede POST admission; its saved cancellation prevents a delayed POST from ringing a new phone. This operation cannot hang up or advance a live customer; use the customer hangup or a new audio change for an active live transport.

get.summary: Read an owned audio connection attempt
get.description: Choose exactly one connection_id, connection_intent_id or current=1. Reads never send a provider command, claim another customer or change a control owner. Current discovery returns working and pending audio under the workspace/actor fence, plus unresolved cleanup, customer-busy state and a versioned predictive customer snapshot. The snapshot recovers missed events or a reloaded screen without starting a call. Older reads cannot replace newer customer state. A new local Start or Stop prevents an old snapshot from restoring its previous room. It retains original-account resources when credentials change. Intent reads resolve the submitted request even when it reused a connection with an older original intent. A canceled or superseded request cannot adopt another request's controls. DELETE does not accept current or a workspace-only query.

post.summary: Start one funded manual customer call
post.description: Session or bearer session only. user_id must be the actor. Queue/contact/campaign/outreach and the selected device are owned. Keep dial_intent_id for retries. Optional audio_connection_id and audio_generation reuse the actor's confirmed idle phone; both fields, a verified phone selected_device and dial_intent_id are required together. Explicit Start calls only the customer with one hold and returns its real SID as JSON. Accepted intent replay precedes mutable source checks. Connect remains connection-only. A new legacy phone setup is refused while this actor has an unresolved audio connection. Without an owned audio operation, legacy requests retain setup-plus-recipient behavior and TwiML success.

post.summary: Handle signed agent audio instructions, status and conference events
post.description: Provider-only POST. Validate the raw Twilio signature over the unchanged full URL and form before alias normalization. The connection UUID, saved callback URL, original account and physical participant facts bind the event. An accepted or answered call does not activate audio. A replacement prejoins muted and cannot dispatch or bill a customer. The first callback owner can end while its original parent/customer bridge remains active; their verified joins and genuine current hangups still apply. A retired source cannot end the current conference. Transient processing or provider-stop failures return 500. New owned audio conference TwiML explicitly retries connection/read failures and 5xx; the saved signed URL excludes the override fragment. An existing conference retains its first participant's delivery policy. Provider retries are finite. Genuine current hangups save a durable stop before provider I/O. Original-account recovery verifies the exact conference name and SID, including after the phone becomes terminal or an acknowledgement is lost. Pending room stops block new audio preparation, sends and initial activation. Live customer promotion, transport commit and media continuity remain in development.

Digits.description: Phone audio requires a signed press-1 Gather confirmation before conference instructions are issued.

ReasonParticipantLeft.description: Only participant_hung_up is a genuine participant hangup; removal and conference end cannot end another audio generation.

200.description: Saved conference instruction or a safe hangup

post.summary: Continue the original manual or SDK parent after its customer Dial
post.description: Provider-only signed POST to the exact URL saved before the one customer instruction. Raw signature validation precedes alias normalization. The saved original account, parent SID, child SID and root facts bind the event. Ordinary completion returns Hangup. A requested and previously joined direct-call promotion can resume its original parent; this never activates the replacement. Failed replacement status alone cannot end the parent, and a committed successor permanently fences that parent. Rejected and closed promotions return Hangup. Fresh provider facts, when available, must match; ended calls return Hangup. Provider verification is bounded to one second: an unavailable API keeps the authenticated original source on its saved target and leaves replacement commit pending. SDK To can be a custom recipient request parameter; actual SDK root identity is checked separately. Dial action delivery explicitly retries connection/read failures and 5xx within the 15-second voice limit; its override fragment is excluded from the saved signed URL. The endpoint never creates a call, changes customer identity, settles a hold, writes disposition or advances a queue. Calls issued without this saved capability cannot be promoted.

200.description: Safe hangup or an owned parent conference instruction; never a new customer

post.description: Authenticated caller+ session or workspace API key. API keys must supply `agentUserId` for a verified caller in the workspace. Reserve four available credits for the first eligible recipient before provider dispatch. Paired `audio_connection_id` and `audio_generation`, a stable `dial_intent_id` and the verified phone as `selected_device` reuse confirmed phone audio: Start calls only the recorded AMD customer and returns the saved conference plus real customer `callSid`. Connect never starts a customer. Accepted retries return the saved identity before mutable phone/campaign/queue checks. Predictive fanout and continuation retain one hold per customer and the first phone callback. Customer departure and queue drain do not close the persistent phone room. New legacy setup is refused while owned audio is unresolved; otherwise legacy setup and the first recipient share the same hold. Voice starts share a limit of 120 requests per minute per authenticated user or API key, across dial, IVR, device connection and voice test calls. A 429 response includes Retry-After in seconds; changing agentUserId does not reset an API key's budget.

sessionCookie.name: better-auth.session_token
sessionCookie.description: Signed Better Auth session cookie for an HTTP deployment. Preserve the name and value issued by the target server. HTTPS deployments use secureSessionCookie. Browsers send their cookie jar; server/script clients can use a workspace API key.

secureSessionCookie.name: __Secure-better-auth.session_token
secureSessionCookie.description: Signed Better Auth session cookie for an HTTPS deployment. Preserve the secure prefix and the value issued by the target server; do not rename an HTTP cookie. Browsers send their cookie jar; server/script clients can use a workspace API key.

apiKey.name: X-API-Key
apiKey.description: Workspace API key (prefix cc_). Alternatively: Authorization: Bearer <key>.

ConversationSummaryMode.description: Return the complete workspace unread message total instead of a conversation page.

WorkspaceId.description: Required in the request body when using session auth. Optional with API key; must match the key workspace if provided.

CreateCampaignWithScriptRequest.description: Provide exactly one of `script` or `script_id` (XOR). Enforced in Zod validation, not in OpenAPI required fields.

type.description: Campaign type (script-based). Use robocall for an IVR.

caller_id.description: Outbound caller ID. Must be a workspace phone number (e.g. +15551234567).

script.description: Inline script to create and attach. Use this OR script_id.

type.description: script for live_call, ivr for IVR types. Defaults from campaign type.

script_id.description: ID of an existing script to attach. Use this OR script.

audience_ids.description: Audience IDs to attach (must belong to workspace).

enqueue_audience_contacts.description: If true, enqueue contacts from attached audiences; if false, only link audiences.

is_active.description: Deprecated: derived from status (running/waiting). Ignored on writes.

campaign.description: Created campaign row (id, title, workspace, type, caller_id, status, ...).

campaignDetails.description: Type-specific details (e.g. live_campaign/ivr_campaign) with campaign_id, script_id.

script.description: Present only when a script was created in this request.

contacts_enqueued.description: Total contacts added to the campaign queue.

ChatSmsRequest.description: Session auth requires workspace_id in the body.

contact_id.description: Optional contact ID. Must identify the unique workspace contact whose normalized phone equals to_number.

media.description: Optional media URL or path for MMS.

messaging_service_sid.description: Optional Twilio Messaging Service SID override.

CampaignSmsDispatchRequest.description: Session auth requires workspace_id. API key auth requires user_id for outreach attribution.

campaign_id.description: Message campaign ID whose queued contacts receive SMS.

caller_id.description: Outbound caller ID. Required when campaign sms_send_mode requires it.

user_id.description: Required when using API key auth (outreach attribution). Session auth uses the logged-in user.

responses.description: Per-contact send results keyed by contact_id (success, skipped, or error).

creditsExhausted.description: True when the workspace balance ran out part-way through the batch: the remaining rows stay queued and no further batch is scheduled until credits are added.

reason.description: Why nothing was sent, e.g. "Outside campaign send window".

nextOpenAt.description: The next instant the campaign's send window allows dispatch.

responses.description: Results for contacts processed before the send window closed. Contacts that remain queued are not included.

CampaignSmsDispatchResponse.description: Either the batch ran (dispatched) or the campaign's send window kept it queued (deferred). Both are 200; check `deferred`.

client_identity.description: Active handset session owned by the signed-in user.

dial_intent_id.description: Keep this UUID when retrying the same dial action.

audio_connection_id.description: Owned confirmed phone connection. Requires audio_generation, dial_intent_id and that verified phone as selected_device.

audio_generation.description: Positive safe integer generation of the confirmed phone connection.

dial_intent_id.description: Reuse this ID when retrying the same conference start. A new call session needs a new ID.

caller_id.description: E.164 caller ID to present on outbound dials.

selected_device.description: computer or a verified E.164 phone. A confirmed phone Start requires its paired audio source fields.

agentUserId.description: Required when authenticating with a workspace API key.

callSid.description: Real customer root SID for a confirmed-phone Start. Legacy setup responses omit this field.

revoked_api_keys.description: Number of workspace API keys permanently revoked by this archive.

ProductCapabilityId.description: Stable product capability ID used as an API-key scope.

expires_at.description: ISO-8601 expiry; null only for pre-SEC-07 legacy keys.

scopes.description: At least one capability scope is required.

key.description: Full secret key; shown once at creation.

status.description: Number lifecycle. Live lists return active rows only.

released_at.description: Release completion time. Null for active numbers.

inbound_script_id.description: An inbound_ivr script in this workspace with valid document and routing targets. Referenced queues must belong to this workspace. Null clears the attachment. Invalid selection preserves the previous configuration.
